KRM-07097330.reference: KRM K07097330; K01035410 glosses the ⺊ form 俗處字
KRM-07097330.witness: Kanchi-in manuscript of the Ruiju Myōgishō, Hōge 97.3.3 (Tenri 391.3.3), copied 1241/1251
KRM-07097330.limitation: Regularized editorial outlines, not a facsimile or an encoded-character identification. The manuscript informs the joined centred stem and extended rightward horizontal dot; each face uses its own 上 and 冖 donors with editorial stem spacing. GlyphWiki is a comparison witness, not an outline donor.
KRM-07097330.pen-writing: Kureedo 上 without its baseline, with editorial stem spacing and an extended rightward bar, over native 冖.

UHK-HUANG-JIN-WAN-LIANG.reference: 揮春上的合體字　你看懂幾多？ (新春篇), UHK 港生活, 2015-02-12
UHK-HUANG-JIN-WAN-LIANG.limitation: A photographed brush 揮春 sets the structure: 金 takes 黄's 八 for its roof, hanging from 由, over 萬's band. Outlines are the face's own 黄 body, 金 with ㇒ and ㇏ for its roof, and 萬 with 岡's 山 for 禸; the boxes are editorial.

MOE-A00836-011.reference: MOE variant dictionary A00836-011, reviewed by 張文彬; cites 《碑別字新編》〈魏元騰墓誌〉
MOE-A00836-011.comparison: https://zi.tools/api/ids/lookupidsasync/%E2%BF%B1%E2%BF%BB%E9%BE%B6%E2%BF%B1%E4%B9%9B%E4%B8%B7%E5%90%8B?replace_token (zi.tools outline, upstream glyph revision unspecified); https://glyphwiki.org/json?name=twedu-a00836-011 (GlyphWiki version 9, a comparison witness, not an outline donor)
MOE-A00836-011.limitation: The witness, a 38×37-pixel scan, sets the arrangement: a stem through three bars, the third hooked, a dot pair either side of the stem, a full-width bar. Outlines are the face's own 壽 with its 丷 in place of 工 and the stem run down to the long bar; the dot placement is editorial. The form does not identify the character.
